name: Rubber sub answers
desc: Digital dancehall sub in B minor answering the kick from the off-positions: short rubbery sine stabs with a fast upward pitch blip that reads as skin snap, walking b7 and fifth turnarounds every fourth bar. Sleng Teng lineage, modern bashment weight.

code.full: note("<[~ ~ ~ b1 ~ ~ b1 ~] [~ ~ ~ b1 ~ ~ a1 ~] [~ ~ ~ b1 ~ ~ b1 ~] [~ ~ ~ f#1 ~ ~ a1 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").penv(5).pdec(.05).attack(.005).decay(.3).sustain(.25).release(.12).shape(.5).lpf(${cut}).gain(${gain}).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[b1 ~ ~ b1 ~ b2 b1 ~] [b1 ~ ~ b1 ~ ~ a1 a2] [b1 ~ ~ b1 ~ b2 b1 ~] [f#1 ~ f#1 ~ a1 ~ b1 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").penv(6).pdec(.04).attack(.004).decay(.28).sustain(.25).release(.1).shape(.55).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.5).slow(8)).gain(${gain}).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
